Workers/createVectorTileClampedPolylines.note: Consecutive duplicate removal, loop detection, mitered start/end faces with the 150 degree break, eight-vertex volumes and reversed reference indices. 15 direct worker cases including loops, reversals, duplicates and 32-bit indices.

Workers/createVectorTilePolygons.note: Color batching in JavaScript object-key order, extruded top/bottom/wall indices, per-polygon heights, oriented bounding boxes and the packed draw-call buffer. Workers/createVectorTileGeometries.note: Instanced unit boxes, cylinders, ellipsoids and spheres with Float32 parameters, tile model matrix, bounding spheres and Vector3DTileBatch packing. 15 direct worker cases including 32-bit indices and missing-input behavior.

Workers/combineGeometry.note: PrimitivePipeline.combineGeometry on packed instances and createGeometry results: world transforms, antimeridian splits, batchId, vertex-cache reorder, 2D projection, high/low encoding, compression, unsigned-short indices, pick offsets, and Float32 bounding spheres. 15 direct worker cases. Workers/createTaskProcessorWorker.note: TaskProcessor onmessage and onmessageerror adapter: task id, parameters, CESIUM_BASE_URL, Error versus non-Error throws, transfer-list clearing, and formatError postMessage failure strings. 41 direct worker cases call the real adapter. Workers/decodeDraco.note: Triangular meshes and point clouds, including non-float and 64-bit attributes, geometry-type errors, and the WebAssembly init message (returns true; no module is compiled) match the CesiumJS worker. dequantizeInShader and attributesToSkipTransform keep quantized POSITION, NORMAL, COLOR and TEX_COORD values with their quantization or octahedral parameters, through SetSkipAttributeTransform in a vendored, patched draco-core 2.3.2 (third_party/draco-core). Workers/transferTypedArrayTest.note: Web Worker onmessage handler whose only job is to postMessage the received typed array back, transferring array.buffer, or an empty object if that transfer throws. A TileBoundingVolumeFrame carries the FrameState fields the volumes read (mode, camera positionWC and positionCartographic, map projection). createDebugVolume returns the outline GeometryInstances (geometry created, id outline, color attribute) that Cesium wraps in a flat, opaque PerInstanceColorAppearance Primitive. Validated through the four volumes in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/TileBoundingSphere.note: Zero radius becomes EPSILON7, distance, plane intersection, update and the sphere outline debug volume. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/TileOrientedBoundingBox.note: Degenerate half-axes replaced by EPSILON7 perpendicular axes (every zero-axis combination), distance, plane intersection, update and the 2x2x2 box outline debug volume. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/TileBoundingRegion.note: Corner and edge-plane construction (including the north and south of the equator plane shifts), 3D and 2D/Columbus/morphing distances with the map projection, the lazy computeBoundingVolumes option, plane intersection and the extruded rectangle outline. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/TileBoundingS2Cell.note: Top, bottom and side planes, Cramer's-rule vertices, edge normals, the face/edge/vertex distance cases, plane intersection and the six coplanar outline instances. An invalid token returns None where S2Cell.fromToken throws. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/BoundingVolumeSemantics.note: TILE_ and CONTENT_ bounding box, region, sphere and height semantics over any MetadataEntity. A BoundingVolumePrefix enum replaces the string prefix, so the DeveloperError for other prefixes cannot occur. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/ImplicitTileCoordinates.note: Quadtree and octree coordinates with Cesium's 32-bit shift arithmetic: child, Morton and tile indices, descendant, ancestor, offset, child and subtree coordinates, ancestry, equality, template values and fromMortonIndex/fromTileIndex, with the range DeveloperErrors as MetadataError::Developer. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/ImplicitAvailabilityBitstream.note: Constant and bitstream availability, the exact-length RuntimeError, optional set-bit counting and getBit (None out of range, where Cesium throws). Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/ImplicitTileset.note: implicitTiling and the 3DTILES_implicit_tiling extension, the supported bounding volume RuntimeError, subtree and content URI templates (contents, content and 3DTILES_multiple_contents), the tile header template and availableLevels/maximumLevel. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/ImplicitSubtree.note: Binary and JSON subtrees: chunk parsing (RangeError and SyntaxError), active buffer and buffer view marking, subarray clamping, constant and bitstream tile/content/child availability, 3DTILES_metadata and property-table tile and content metadata, subtree metadata, jump buffers with their typed-array wrapping, tile and child subtree indices and metadata views. External buffers come from a caller-supplied load_buffer callback instead of ResourceCache, and the subtree is built synchronously. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/ImplicitSubtreeCache.note: Ancestor-first, then oldest-first eviction past maximumSubtreeCount (never the subtree just added), find by coordinates in queue order and the missing-parent DeveloperError after insertion. Generic over a CachedSubtree trait. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tiling.rs.

Scene/Atmosphere.note: Atmosphere defaults, dynamic lighting, epsilon-based HSB correction and renderer uniform snapshot; direct CesiumJS fixtures in scene_runtime.

Scene/Fog.note: Density/height/direction falloff, mode and height disabling, renderability and frame parameters; five CesiumJS sequences with 480 updates.

Scene/FrameState.note: Complete FrameState data surface and defaults, including services, environment, shadow state, metadata picking, pass overrides and deferred callbacks. Typed resource handles retain subsystem ownership; UniformFrame requires an initialized camera/projection/time/culling volume instead of JS undefined. Two direct CesiumJS default/service cases in scene_completion.

Scene/Scene.note: Executable frame/event/primitive runtime, clipping, mixed-LOD stencil, transforms and color picking; now integrates View depth/MSAA resources, weighted OIT, classification command plumbing and depth/drill/ray/metadata/height/most-detailed picking APIs. 416 GPU comparisons validate existing render/color-pick paths plus depth resources/OIT and the tile-classification depth handoff. MSAA depth is resolved before OIT and packed tile depth is updated before classification. Globe/terrain, shadows/post-processing, remaining classification/picking GPU validation and controller/morph integration remain; docs/scene.md.

Scene/Cesium3DTileset.note: JSON/schema/Ion loading, exact volumes, base/skip/most-detailed traversal with foveated/progressive priorities, external/multiple/implicit content expansion, expiry, CPU height queries/callbacks, async lifecycle, shared texture accounting and LRU. Reference trees, S2/metadata expansion and lifecycle tests. Rendering formats require a content factory; plane clipping and mixed-LOD stencil/backface rendering are executable; styling/polygon clipping/imagery/environment/debug remain; docs/scene.md.

Scene/DerivedCommand.note: Depth-only, logarithmic depth, HDR, pick and metadata-pick shader transformations/render states with ShaderCache support. Original ShaderSource fragments survive compilation. 47 direct CesiumJS cases; Scene GPU integration checks 24 WebGL2 pixel comparisons.

Scene/Cesium3DTilesetBaseTraversal.note: Source traversal over owned tile IDs: replacement/additive selection, empty/external descendants, ancestor fallback, mixed-content selection depths, request/cache bookkeeping and priority holders. 144 direct CesiumJS deep-tree cases across base/skip/most-detailed passes in scene_completion; rendering and tile-specific clipping remain owned by their respective modules.

Scene/Cesium3DTilesetSkipTraversal.note: Source traversal over owned tile IDs: replacement/additive selection, empty/external descendants, ancestor fallback, mixed-content selection depths, request/cache bookkeeping and priority holders. 144 direct CesiumJS deep-tree cases across base/skip/most-detailed passes in scene_completion; rendering and tile-specific clipping remain owned by their respective modules.

Scene/Cesium3DTilesetMostDetailedTravers.note: Source traversal over owned tile IDs: replacement/additive selection, empty/external descendants, ancestor fallback, mixed-content selection depths, request/cache bookkeeping and priority holders. 144 direct CesiumJS deep-tree cases across base/skip/most-detailed passes in scene_completion; rendering and tile-specific clipping remain owned by their respective modules.

Scene/Cesium3DTilesetTraversal.note: Shared traversal, child sorting, selection/style tracking, visibility/union optimization, touch/request deduplication, motion/foveated deferral and priority extrema. Validated with 144 direct CesiumJS traversal cases; the tile owns its content/visibility implementation.

Scene/View.note: Camera movement, visible sets, exact frustum fitting/binning, compute/overlay routing, shadow ranges and debug overlap; now owns pick, depth, Scene/id, globe depth/translucency, edge, OIT and classification resources. 48 fitting cases, nine movement sequences, resource lifecycle fixtures and real GPU depth/OIT comparisons. Complete integration/validation with the remaining Scene effects is pending.

Scene/ClippingPlane.note: Plane parameters, normal-component setters, notifications before mutation and unowned clones. Typed callbacks receive a borrowed plane to inspect old parameters safely. Three direct CesiumJS mutation sequences in scene_clipping.

Scene/ClippingPlaneCollection.note: Collection/equality removal/events/indexing, single-owner lifetime, union/intersection volume tests and transformed planes, float/Oct32 byte packing, retained/resized GPU textures and partial uploads. 18 CesiumJS sequences and real WebGL1/WebGL2 texture/clipping comparisons. Empty unallocated textures have native zero dimensions.

Scene/SceneTransforms.note: World/canvas/drawing-buffer transforms, eye offsets, actual ellipsoid positions in all modes, 2D infinite-scroll wrapping and current-frustum depth/log-depth reconstruction. Typed SceneTransformState carries canvas/projection inputs. 259 direct CesiumJS reference cases in scene_transforms.

Scene/PickFramebuffer.note: Reusable RGBA/depth-stencil framebuffer, per-pass scissor/blend overrides, source spiral order and object-identity deduplication, center pixels, PBO/fence async readback, cancellation/timeout cleanup and WebGL1 synchronous object snapshot. 112 direct reference cases and 176 Scene picking GPU comparisons; host futures replace afterRender scheduling.

Scene/Picking.note: Color sync/async picking and culling plus depth positions, metadata/voxel reads, drill/ray/height APIs and most-detailed preload queues. Color picking has pinned-source/GPU parity; native tests cover restoration, visibility and queue lifetimes. Independent GPU validation of the newly added depth-position/metadata/ray/most-detailed paths remains.

Scene/SceneFramebuffer.note: Owned color/id depth-stencil targets, HDR/MSAA resize, resolve, clear and destruction; pinned View resource lifecycle and real GPU framebuffer cases.

Scene/PickDepthFramebuffer.note: Depth-stencil pick target with source buffer sizing/scissor, lifecycle and pinned GPU resource cases.

Scene/PickDepth.note: Scene/globe packed depth merge, readback and decoding; 36 reference decoding cases and WebGL1/WebGL2 depth GPU comparisons.

Scene/GlobeDepth.note: Render/pick depth targets, packed copy, stencil-masked merge, color copy, resolve, automatic texture and destruction; real GPU HDR/MSAA/scissor/stencil comparisons.

Scene/GlobeTranslucencyFramebuffer.note: Classification color/depth target and packed depth, resize and destruction; preserves upstream updateAndClear behavior and compares real GPU outputs.

Scene/EdgeFramebuffer.note: Three color attachments with depth-stencil, HDR, clear and external exposure semantics; pinned resource and real GPU comparisons.

Scene/OIT.note: Weighted MRT and two-pass fallback, exact derived shader/render states, GPU adjust/composite/clear and ownership; 12 source variants and 16 actual GPU comparisons. Rendering supplies the output declaration missing in the pinned WebGL2 fallback shader.

Scene/MetadataPicking.note: Raw little-endian component/element/array decoding, 64-bit BigInts, normalization, value transforms and vector/matrix objects; 500 pinned-source cases. Shader pipeline rejects variable-length arrays.

Scene/TranslucentTileClassification.note: Owned translucent depth, packed depth and classification accumulation targets; Scene command routing and sampler restoration implemented. Independent GPU classification comparisons still pending.

Scene/PickedMetadataInfo.note: Owned metadata shader selection, class property and optional value transform; integrated with Scene metadata reads. End-to-end metadata-render validation pending.

Scene/ResourceLoader.note: Typed lifecycle trait, contextual errors, shared load futures, weak ownership and cancellation guards; pinned error/lifecycle fixtures and native cancellation tests. Host drives scheduler cleanup after cancellation.

Scene/BufferLoader.note: Embedded byte views and ResourceClient external loads with idempotent requests, failure caching, unload/destroy and zero-copy ownership. Nine pinned lifecycle cases plus native pending-request cancellation checks.

Scene/MetadataSchemaLoader.note: Embedded or fetched schemas, shared load/failure state, unload/destruction and typed MetadataSchema parsing. Nine pinned lifecycle cases.

Scene/GltfJsonLoader.note: JSON, bytes, URI and GLB ingestion; data URI buffers, legacy upgrades, defaults, required-extension checks and pipeline cleanup. Shares embedded and upgraded buffers through optional ResourceCache leases. 28 pinned cases and native JSON/GLB-to-buffer-view integration.

Scene/GltfBufferViewLoader.note: Zero-copy views, external/embedded/legacy-upgraded buffers, shared BufferLoader leases and meshopt v0/v1 attributes, triangle/index decoding and octahedral/quaternion/exponential filters. 44 pinned cases plus bounds/failure/cancellation and JSON/GLB integration tests.

Scene/GltfLoaderUtil.note: Image format selection, validated samplers and KHR_texture_transform texture readers; 99 pinned cases across both suites. Typed ModelComponents texture readers and FrameResource reader facade share transform helpers.

Scene/ResourceCacheKey.note: All cache identities and JS JSON/property/number semantics, including missing fields and meshopt buffer-ID quirks; 284 pinned cases. Typed ResourceCache facade and public functions share one implementation.

Scene/ResourceCacheStatistics.note: Deduplicated CPU/GPU geometry and texture byte accounting, removal and clear; four pinned sequences plus loader integration checks.

Scene/ResourceCache.note: Typed owner-scoped cache, reference-counted leases, ordered destruction, shared schema/JSON/buffer/view/Draco/vertex/index/image/texture factories and memory accounting. SPZ factory remains unported. Pinned ownership traces, native dependency/cancellation and real GPU lease checks.

Scene/GltfDracoLoader.note: Cached or host-supplied buffer views, capacity-limited task processing, decoder initialization, frame-driven decoding, quantization skips, errors and cancellation. Nine pinned real-codec scenarios plus native capacity/failure/destruction checks; hosts can use background workers.

Scene/Cesium3DTileFeatureTable.note: JSON and binary global/per-feature properties with the per-semantic typed-array cache (the first component type wins), componentType overrides, createTypedArray conversion of JSON values, and JavaScript typed-array RangeErrors for unaligned or out-of-range views relative to the tile buffer. Nine pinned call sequences.

Scene/B3dmParser.note: Current and both legacy headers, feature/batch table sections, zero-copy feature table and glb views with copied batch binaries, unaligned-glb copies, embedded byte offsets, and upstream's DataView/Uint8Array/JSON errors. Deprecation warnings are returned. 16 pinned tiles.

Scene/I3dmParser.note: Embedded glb and URI formats, feature/batch table sections, unaligned copies, embedded byte offsets and version/format/feature-table errors. Ten pinned tiles.

Scene/PntsParser.note: Float and quantized positions, RGBA/RGB/RGB565/constant colors, float and oct-encoded normals, batch IDs, binary or JSON globals (including one-element typed-array POINTS_LENGTH/BATCH_LENGTH), RTC centers, 3DTILES_draco_point_compression buffers and combined properties, empty batch tables and removal of unresolved binary references (names returned instead of a one-time warning). Keeps upstream's always-false hasConstantColor. 24 pinned tiles including every error path.

Scene/GltfVertexBufferLoader.note: Buffer-view and Draco CPU/GPU loading, quantization metadata, upload budgets, retained arrays and statistics; 33 pinned cases and WebGL1/2 indexed draw/readback checks. SPZ attributes remain unported.

Scene/GltfIndexBufferLoader.note: Buffer-view/Draco indices, unaligned byte offsets, actual GPU allocation, deferred uploads, CPU retention and destruction/accounting; nine pinned cases, native failure checks and WebGL1/2 GPU comparisons.

Scene/ModelComponents.note: All 27 data classes and AnimatedPropertyType with upstream defaults and DEFAULT_* constants. Shared node/skin/sampler references are indices into their owning arrays; GPU buffers and textures are generic over the Gl host, with textures shared through Rc. StructuralMetadata and ModelPrimitiveImagery references use optional FrameResource handles pending those runtime modules. 29 pinned default/constant cases.

Scene/DracoLoader.note: Owned (not static) decodeDraco task processor created on the first request with the host TaskWorker: module initialization, deferred readiness, falsy/failed initialization errors and concurrency of hardwareConcurrency - 1. Pinned scheduling timelines for buffer views and point clouds.

Scene/GltfImageLoader.note: Shared embedded/URI/data-URI image loading, signature-based PNG/JPEG/WebP host decoding, real KTX2/Basis transcoding and mip splitting; unload, error chains and cancellation. 79 pinned cases, pending decode/transport ownership checks and real browser decoding/GPU comparisons.

Scene/GltfTextureLoader.note: Cached image leases, deferred uploads, glTF samplers, compressed no-mipmap fallback, NPOT host resizing, typed/compressed mip chains, destruction and statistics. 40 pinned cases plus real PNG/JPEG/WebP/KTX2 WebGL1/2 comparisons, quota separation, error/retry and shared-decode checks.

Scene/PropertyTextureProperty.note: Texture info plus channels: a texture reader over the model's textures by glTF index, channel indices as "rgba" letters with charAt's truncation and out-of-range empties, and offset/scale inherited from the class property and unpacked for uniforms. A metadata vector scale shares the texture info's scale key; the reader keeps only a number. 12 pinned cases in tests/scene_structural_metadata.rs.

Scene/PropertyTexture.note: Properties of one class stored in textures, keyed in JavaScript order; ids are indices or legacy dictionary keys (MetadataId). Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_structural_metadata.rs.

Scene/StructuralMetadata.note: Schema with property tables, textures and attributes; table count, byte length, statistics and lookups. destroy is Drop. Generic over the GL host for its property textures. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_structural_metadata.rs.

Scene/getMetadataProperty.note: First property texture of the class with the property; attributes are not searched, as upstream. Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_structural_metadata.rs.

Scene/parseStructuralMetadata.note: EXT_structural_metadata tables, textures and attributes, plus the RGBA8 property table texture: every GPU-compatible class property in class order, missing ones filled with noData written as upstream does (unscaled j + k offsets, enum and array-of-scalar failures), size checks against the context limit, and console/one-time warnings returned. Textures are uploaded through the Renderer and compared byte for byte; 13 pinned cases.

Scene/parseFeatureMetadataLegacy.note: EXT_feature_metadata feature tables and textures sorted by UTF-16 key with string ids, channel strings to indices, and texture info deep-combined with each property. 3 pinned extensions in tests/scene_structural_metadata.rs.

Scene/parseBatchTable.note: 3D Tiles 1.0 batch tables: JSON, hierarchy (including the deprecated HIERARCHY) and binary properties as a transcoded _batchTable class, either a binary MetadataTable or point cloud property attributes with custom vertex attributes (sanitized GLSL names, placeholders, Draco arrays, float casts). JavaScript's byte offset arithmetic and typed-array RangeErrors; warnings returned. 16 pinned batch tables.

Scene/preprocess3DTileContent.note: Binary payloads by magic number (glTF renamed glb), JSON by root/asset/tileAvailability/type/voxelTable in upstream's order, and its errors including null JSON. 29 pinned payloads in tests/scene_tile_content.rs.

Scene/TileReplacementQueue.note: Least-recently-rendered tile list with the start-of-frame marker and trimming; the queue keeps the links by tile id and unloads through a callback. Nine pinned scripts (one fixed, eight random, 498 steps) compared after every step in both directions.

Scene/Cesium3DContentGroup.note: Holds a content's group metadata (an owned copy, as GroupMetadata owns its properties). Direct CesiumJS cases in tests/scene_tile_content.rs.

DataSources/CallbackProperty.note: Lazy time/result callbacks, callback identity, constant flag, injectable/browser clocks and reentrant callback replacement. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/CompositeProperty.note: Interval-selected properties, time/result forwarding, equality and deduplicated child subscriptions rewired before notification; weak ownership. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/ConstantProperty.note: Typed stored values, change suppression, equality, value extraction and toString; owned math clones and reference-identity adapters. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/Property.note: Typed optional-value contract and equality/default helpers, including cloned-default result behavior; local Rc events and owned values replace dynamic JS objects. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/PropertyArray.note: Time-coherent child evaluation, undefined/null compaction, equality and deduplicated child listeners with weak forwarding and RAII cleanup. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/SampledProperty.note: Packed/individual/bulk sorted samples and replacement, scalar/vector/quaternion codecs, Linear/Lagrange/Hermite/custom interpolation, derivatives, bounded extrapolation, equality and sample removal. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.

DataSources/TimeIntervalCollectionProper.note: Observable Core interval collections, raw value cloning, inclusion/overlap/removal, identity merging and fallible source-compatible equality. Validated in the 206-case pinned DataSources suite and native lifecycle tests.
